user.title: Set up Ortsnetz Map
user.description: Sets up server-side retrieval of map points from ortsnetz-auslastung.de. The map automatically uses the Home Assistant location as its center.

init.title: Configure Ortsnetz Map
init.description: Sets how long fetched data (map points, 24-hour counters and site histories) is cached and how long to wait after a failed fetch. The integration reloads after saving.

data_description.cache_max_age: Map points, counters and histories are served without a new fetch for this long (60–3600 s, default 300 s).
data_description.retry_after_error: No new attempt is made for this long after a failed fetch; existing data keeps being served (30–600 s, default 60 s).
